fusions.name: Apex Pull
fusions.desc: Casts a heavy link that deals 30 damage, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Tightening Orbit
fusions.desc: Draws a ring of links around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Blood Scent
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 15 seconds. An escort of links fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Taste of Red
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 6 seconds. Once every 18 seconds.
